source_basis.source_scope: received WEB John coordinate and text surface plus its direct internal canonical cross-reference metadata only
source_basis.editorial_metadata_guard: Headings, paragraphs, punctuation, red letters, footnotes, Strong-style numbers, cross-reference formatting, witness labels, and variants are evidence only.

coverage_contract.routing_principle: Prefer complete poetic-prose openings, witness sequences, signs with immediate responses, dialogues, investigations, festival controversies, farewell movements, prayer, trial sequences, passion and appearance episodes, epilogue movements, and exact competing routes.

second_temple_primary.classification: direct-period context eligible only with source-specific dating and provenance
second_temple_primary.guard: No external Second Temple primary source was read; future use may inform context but cannot dictate a seam, identity, fulfillment, theology, community reconstruction, or history.

modern_second_temple_reconstruction.guard: Expose evidence chain and uncertainty and retain no seam authority.

early_rabbinic_reception.classification: reception or comparative evidence requiring source-specific dating, redaction, and transmission controls

later_rabbinic_reception.classification: reception only, never direct first-century context

parallel_policy.note: No Synoptic, Acts, epistle, Revelation, or other John proposal, map, or parallel table was read.

variant_and_received_coordinate_guard.guard: Every variant, received coordinate, witness, punctuation, heading, red-letter span, and placement question remains LOW evidence only. No witness, reading, location, originality, authenticity, authorship, doctrine, history, or canon is selected.

routing_principle: Use participant, festival, location, time, action, witness, question-misunderstanding-response, sign-response, investigation, metaphor, refrain, farewell transition, prayer, and closure evidence. Repetition alone neither forces a split nor a merge. All decisions remain LOW and deferred.
